scope.interpretation: Each numeric PERIM is hypothesis-only; observations apply only to its separately captured case.

limitations: Each result is limited to one explicit post-MAIN ZERO-EDGE call with START direct coordinates (3, 3, 0), that case’s numeric PERIM hypothesis, and a fresh zero-filled 7x7 UBYTE4 scratch FILL-MAP.

Captured return values or target conditions, START slot changes, all 49 scratch cells, RNG previews, dynamic bindings, and full original-map preservation checks apply only to the corresponding individual call.
No general behavior is inferred for other START coordinates, PERIM values, map dimensions, callers, scene contexts, or native call paths.

Original FILL-MAP and PATCH-MAP dimensions are read from each run’s current picture bindings and are bounded to 1,048,576 cells; full identity and cell comparisons are checked against the reported restoration result.
Random-state evidence is limited to the probe’s bounded preview draws around the constructor and target call; it does not establish full random-state purity.
Two fresh uninstrumented controls are byte-compared with each other and every instrumented case for AA0, raw scene report, image, image ID, executable, PLL, and all 12 runtime application files.
